sources.feature_id: FID 430; BLDG_ABBR HAGL; Marc and Sharon Hagle Hall
sources.source_date: Layer metadata describes campus buildings; individual geometry edit date is not populated
sources.source_crs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326), explicitly requested via outSR=4326
sources.measurement_method: Use all 74 vertices of the closed FID 430 polygon, projected using the approximate local formula mandated by modular/AGENTS.md: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040. The projected polygon shoelace area is 845.68 m2.
sources.uncertainty: This is a campus GIS building outline, not a survey. The layer's Shape__Area attribute is not consistent with the requested WGS84-ring projected area, so the geometry coordinates are the reproducible footprint evidence; no claim is made that the GIS area attribute is metric.

sources.feature_id: Marc and Sharon Hagle Hall project announcement
sources.measurement_method: The university describes a $20 million, 37,500-square-foot, four-story facility at the southeast corner of Third and Russell Streets. Four stories are treated as documented; per-floor and total heights are model estimates.
sources.uncertainty: The article supports identity, gross floor area, story count, and location but supplies no measured elevations or facade dimensions.

sources.provider: Purdue University News / Administrative Operations Communications
sources.feature_id: Hagle Hall construction photograph and completion update
sources.measurement_method: Visual inspection of the exterior image: four-level facade, dark brick wall wings, pale curved corner bay with glazing, ground-floor storefront glazing, and blue angular roof canopy. Used only for architectural cues, not dimensional scaling.
sources.uncertainty: Construction-stage oblique photo; exact facade orientation, fenestration cadence, color values, canopy geometry, and heights are not dimensioned.

sources.provider: Purdue University Vice Provost for Student Life
sources.measurement_method: Identity and project context cross-check; no dimensions derived.
sources.uncertainty: Groundbreaking photo is not an architectural elevation or measurable reference.

model.footprint_status: Rebuilt from Purdue GIS FID 430 ring and projected to campus coordinates; source polygon area is approximately 845.68 m2. Main wall bounds closely follow the GIS outline; the projecting curved-bay canopy extends about 2.75 m beyond part of that outline.
model.orientation: Directly follows the GIS boundary vertex order and local projection; no independent survey or cardinal facade schedule was found.
model.height_basis: Four stories documented by Purdue; floor-to-floor module 3.55 m plus 0.9 m parapet is a modeling estimate, not a surveyed height.
model.facade_representation: Single-mesh shell with dark brick wings, a broadly glazed faceted curved bay, pale stone transitions, glazed ground level, a clearly framed entry door, and a projecting angular blue canopy above the curved bay. Bay glazing, canopy geometry, entry placement, and story heights remain visual estimates from Purdue's 2022 construction photo.
model.export: One mesh object in expected scene and collection; campus-coordinate geometry retained with identity transform; no external image dependencies or linked libraries.
